description: Packet builder endpoint shapes (design.md §4.3). B2's fake server serves these bodies; B1's route tests assert their responses against them. A change to an endpoint's shape is a change to this file, made on the branch that owns it at the time, in a fixture-only commit.

conventions.refusal_body: Every refusal is JSON with a human `error` string. Every packet refusal also carries a `code`. Only two shared refusals have no code: the CSRF 400 and the POST rate-limit 429 (see shared below). A launch-hardening limit (LimitError) in a packet route's own job is answered by that route with a code, never by the app-wide handler, which has none: `rejected` on stage, `limit` on thumb, page and build.
conventions.ids: stage_id is secrets.token_urlsafe(16): 22 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. holder (the tab id) is 22 to 32 characters of the same alphabet.
conventions.key: hash:engine:paper. hash is the sha256 of the uploaded bytes in lowercase hex. A PDF has empty engine and paper, so its key is '<hash>::' whatever the paper.
conventions.type: The upload's extension, lowercase, without the dot.
conventions.not_found: A bad id, a bad page index, an expired id and another owner's id all get the same 404. The client reads any 404 on a staged id as expired.
conventions.build_refusal: A build refusal from the packet checks or from packet_pipeline's PacketError is 400 {error, code, items}: code is PacketError.code (the first item's code when items is not empty), items lists {id, code} for each bad item and is empty for a packet-wide refusal. Item codes: expired, stale, out_of_range, unreadable, encrypted, invalid. Packet-wide codes: invalid, empty, too_large (over the per-build byte cap, or over 2000 output pages), limit (a launch-hardening limit in the build's job). unsupported is retired: cover and divider pages build since B3 and the contents page since B5, so no packet the server plans has a page without a renderer.
conventions.json_bodies: hold and build read a JSON body of at most 1 MiB (pdf_ops/limits.FORM_FIELD_BYTES). A larger body is the 413 upload_too_large with limit_mb 1, before it is parsed.

bad_request.note: A malformed form: no file part or more than one file, a file part with no name, a paper other than letter or a4, or a holder that isn't 22 to 32 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-].

body.error: Bad stage request.

rejected.note: The file can't be read or converted: validate_upload, a converter error, or one of launch-hardening's limits. `error` is the short reason the card shows. A PDF the job can't open is `unreadable`; one that needs a password is `encrypted` (below).

body.error: This file is not a valid PDF.
This PDF is damaged and can't be read.
This PDF needs a password. Remove the password and add it again.

too_large.note: The converted PDF is over the tier's per-build cap (§4.6), so no build could use it.

body.error: This file is 61 MB as a PDF. A packet can use at most 50 MB of files.
Over your staging limit.

staging_quota.note: The ruled caps (round note [C5]): 200 MB and 100 files per subject.

body.error: Docist is busy, try again later.

upload_too_large.note: From utils/uploads.py, unchanged: the body over the request limit (too_large), and also a text field over 1 MiB, too many parts, or a chunked body over the limit (its 413 handler, same code and fields).

body.error: This upload is over the 50 MB limit.
Another file is still being prepared. Trying again shortly.

server_error.note: Not a refusal: the server failed (the job couldn't start, or the disk failed). The card shows error.

body.error: Docist couldn't stage this file. Try again.

request.limits: keep and release together carry at most 500 ids.

ok.note: live maps each kept id that is still live to its page count. gone lists kept ids that are expired, unknown or another owner's. Released ids appear in neither.

body.error: Bad hold request.

bad_request.note: A body that isn't a JSON object, a holder of the wrong shape, keep or release not lists of strings, an id in both lists, or over 500 ids.

body.error: This request is over the 1 MB limit.

request.w: 160 or 320; other values are clamped to those.

ok.note: A page over FRAME_PIXELS gets a 200 'too large to preview' tile image, not an error.

body.error: Not found.

limit.note: A launch-hardening limit other than the frame limit (memory, time) stopped the render. The client leaves the tile's placeholder.

body.error: This took longer than Docist allows for one request (90 seconds, counting the upload). Try a smaller file or fewer pages.
Too many previews at once.
Docist couldn't render this page.

request.w: 160, 320 or 1200; other values are clamped to those.

body.error: Not found.

limit.note: A launch-hardening limit other than the frame limit (memory, time) stopped the render. The client leaves the tile's placeholder.

body.error: This took longer than Docist allows for one request (90 seconds, counting the upload). Try a smaller file or fewer pages.
Too many previews at once.
Docist couldn't render this page.

ok.note: X-Docist-Usage-Remaining and X-Docist-Usage-Limit read 'unlimited' for a tier with no limit. filename is served by the existing GET /download?filename=.

bad_items.note: PacketError or the route's own fit check with items. code is the first item's code. Item codes: expired (missing, unknown, expired or another owner's stage), stale (refs that don't fit the stage), out_of_range (a src at or past the page count), unreadable, encrypted, invalid.

body.error: Some files can't be used. Re-add them and build again.
This packet uses 62 MB of files. A packet can use at most 50 MB.

too_many_pages.note: PacketError from packet_pipeline's 2000-page cap; it reuses too_large.

body.error: A packet can have at most 2000 pages.

invalid.note: A malformed packet, item or options, or a body without a packet object, a stages object of strings, and a holder of the right shape. items lists the bad items when known.

body.error: This packet is malformed.
The packet has no pages.

limit.note: A launch-hardening limit (memory, time, a file over the size cap) stopped the build's job. error is the limit's own message.

body.error: This file needs more memory to convert than Docist allows for one request. Try a smaller file or split it.

upload_too_large.note: A JSON body over 1 MiB (conventions.json_bodies). No items: the body was not read.

body.error: This request is over the 1 MB limit.
You've used today's 10 free operations. Create a free account and verify your email for 20 a day at /signup — or come back after midnight UTC.
Another file is still being prepared. Trying again shortly.

server_error.note: Not a refusal: the server failed. items is empty.

body.error: Docist couldn't build this packet. Try again.

csrf.note: utils/csrf.py _refuse() for a fetch. No code. The client shows 'Reload the page. Your arrangement is saved.'

body.error: Session expired — reload the page and try again.
Too many requests — please wait a moment and try again.
